section_title: HIV infected test subject; compliance with reporting requirements; definitions.
display_path: MI Code / Chapter 333 / Act Act-368-of-1978 / Section 333.20169
text:
Sec. 20169.

A health facility or agency licensed under this article that obtains from a test subject a test result that indicates that the test subject is HIV infected shall comply with the reporting requirements of section 5114.

As used in this section:

"HIV" means human immunodeficiency virus.

"HIV infected" means that term as defined in section 5101.

History: Add. 1988, Act 489, Eff. Mar. 30, 1989
